scope: Whole-body magpie event animation sprite atlases

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent square PNG sprite atlas for a Korean magpie logo animation. Reference image is style and identity reference, specifically its BOTTOM RIGHT standing bird: rounded head, tiny white eye, short pointed bill, dark brown ink silhouette, white belly and wing patch, long tail held diagonally upright toward right. Create exactly NINE complete whole-body drawings in strict THREE columns by THREE rows of equal cells. Facing left unless the head direction below changes, body always facing left. No separated body parts. Row1: neutral standing looking left; curious head turned near-front toward viewer; head turned back to look right over shoulder. Row2: mild forward lean looking down into well; deep forward lean looking straight down below feet; normal standing with eye closed in blink. Row3: sleepy head dipping; asleep relaxed eyes closed head slightly tucked; alert awake head lifted. Preserve same body size, foot size, wing markings and tail length throughout. Every cell has both feet PLANTED on identical invisible baseline at 84% of cell height, center between toes at 40% cell width; whole bird including upright tail within 8%-92% cell bounds. Draw poses as naturally connected bird anatomy, not rotated cutout pieces. Keep whole tail root smooth, no jutting triangle. Flat warm near-black brown #2e2a26 and opaque white markings only, no feather texture, no gradients or shadows. Actual transparent exterior alpha. No perch, well, floor, worm, text, labels, grid, checkerboard or watermark. Clean coherent mini logo artwork. Nine poses, one bird per cell.

Ground baseline same at84% cellheight, foot contact center40%cellwidth. Full extremities fit inside central84% ofcell with8%margin. Flat clean filled logo art, #2e2a26 ink and white markings only, real transparent outer alpha. No floor, perch, tree, well, shadow, gradients, feather veins, text, labels, grid or checkerboard.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: transparent sprite atlas for subtle wildlife events beside a Korean magpie logo. Reference image establishes only flat dark-brown/white style. Draw ONE atlas in strict THREE columns by TWO rows, each equal rectangular cell contains ONE small full creature. TOP ROW is a single tiny friendly inchworm in three successive rightward crawling poses: frame1 low extended body; frame2 middle of body arched up in a loop with head and tail grounded; frame3 extended body with head raised slightly. Rounded segmented silhouette, tiny simple head looking right, at most one tiny white eye, no antenna comedy and no excessive legs, natural cute little caterpillar. BOTTOM ROW is ONE tiny delicate butterfly in three successive wingbeat poses: frame1 both wings fully open symmetrically in gentle three-quarter view; frame2 wings half folded upwards; frame3 narrow wings nearly closed upright. Body facing upper-right, simple natural four-lobed wings and fine antennae. Use same creature identity and body size through each row; bodycenter identical across cells. Dark warm-brown #2e2a26 with restrained white butterfly markings. Fill only central60% of every cell; keep20% margin each side. Clean flat miniature logo silhouettes, no outlines, gradients, shading, textures, birds, plants, floor, text, labels, cell grid or checkerboard. Real transparent alpha exterior. All extremities fully inside each cell.
